arguments.content:
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import os

def render_html_to_png(html_path, output_path):
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1080})
        # Use file:// URL for local files
        file_url = f"file://{os.path.abspath(html_path)}"
        page.goto(file_url, wait_until="networkidle")
        # Give charts time to render
        page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        # Take a full page screenshot
        page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
        browser.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    render_html_to_png("/app/output/dashboard.html", "/app/output/result.png")

steps.message:
I have successfully generated the data visualization and saved it to `/app/output/result.png`. 

The chart provides a publication-ready, data-dense editorial layout featuring three interconnected panels:
1. **Global Disease Burden Shift** (Stacked bar chart) to immediately contrast the shift from a communicable majority in 1990 to an NCD-dominated burden in 2024.
2. **Burden Composition by Income Group** (100% stacked bar chart) to highlight stark disparities between low and high-income nations.
3. **Rank Shift of Top 10 DALY Causes** (Slope chart) to emphasize large rank changes dynamically, with drops in communicable diseases and surges in chronic conditions made visually prominent.

The visualization consistently maps disease categories to specific colors across all charts to ensure cross-panel traceability.
